units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Go reads and writes PDF documents, converts them to PDF/A and PDF/UA formats, and supports document manipulation operations such as splitting, appending, rotating, and reordering pages. It writes PDF content using flow-based and low-level drawing APIs, including text, tables, lists, shapes, and annotations, and can export to HTML, SVG, Markdown, and EPUB. It validates PDF/A and PDF/UA compliance, applies encryption and digital signatures with LTV support, and inspects existing signatures. It also provides AI-powered capabilities for image description, OCR, and document summarization through copilot interfaces.

It splits a document into per-page documents with Document.Split, appends another document's pages in place with Document.Append, rotates pages with Document.Rotate, rearranges pages by an explicit 1-based index slice with Document.Reorder, sets document metadata through Document.SetInfo, and writes XMP metadata packets with Document.SetXMP.

It encrypts documents with AES-128 or AES-256 using user and owner passwords and granular permissions, signs documents with PKCS#7-detached signatures supporting PAdES, DocMDP, and RFC 3161 timestamps, verifies signatures with Document.VerifySignatures, and embeds revocation evidence as LTV with SignOptions.LTV.

It writes paragraphs, headings, tables, and lists with Flow.AddParagraph, Flow.AddTable, and Flow.AddList, renders them to paginated content, and produces a tagged PDF for PDF/UA accessibility when FlowOptions.Tagged is enabled.

It draws vector content on pages with Page.DrawLine, Page.DrawRectangle, Page.DrawCircle, and Page.DrawPath, builds multi-page tables with repeating headers and cell merging, and creates repeating-motif tiling patterns with Document.CreateTilingPattern.

It adds text fields and barcode fields to forms with Form.AddTextField and Form.AddBarcodeField, reads and manipulates annotations on a page with Page.Annotations, and irreversibly removes content from marked regions with RedactAnnotation.

It converts documents toward archival conformance with Document.ConvertToPDFA and Document.ConvertToPDFUA, validates documents against PDF/A and PDF/UA standards with Document.ValidatePDFA and Document.ValidatePDFUA, and embeds fonts and writes required metadata identifiers during conversion.

It renders pages to raster images with Document.RenderImage, exports documents as HTML, SVG, Markdown, and EPUB with Document.SaveHTML, Document.SaveSVG, Document.SaveMarkdown, and Document.SaveEpub, and supports reflowable and native vector modes for each format.

It summarizes documents with ai.SummaryCopilot, performs OCR and writes recognized text as an invisible, selectable layer with ai.NewLLMOCREngine, answers questions with conversation history via ai.ChatCopilot, and generates /Alt text for tagged figures with ai.NewImageDescriptionCopilot.
This example opens a PDF, splits it into individual page files, and merges two PDFs into one, demonstrating core document manipulation with Aspose.PDF FOSS for Go.

The entry point is the Document class, which opens PDFs and writes them back, and the ai subpackage that provides AI copilots for summarization, chat, and image description.

The Document class opens PDFs via Open, OpenStream, OpenWithPassword, or OpenStreamWithPassword and writes them with Document.WriteTo, while Document.OpenAction, Document.Save, and Document.WriteTo support open actions, saving, and writing to any destination.
Flow is a document generator that lays content out top-to-bottom and paginates automatically, with Flow.AddParagraph and Flow.AddTable adding content and Flow.Render producing the final document.
Form provides access to the document's AcroForm, with Form.AddTextField and Form.AddBarcodeField adding form fields and Form.Flatten merging field values into the page content.

AnnotationCollection is the live, ordered set of annotations attached to a single page, with AnnotationCollection.Add and AnnotationCollection.Delete modifying the collection and Page.Annotations exposing it.

Document.SetEncryption applies password or certificate-based encryption using EncryptionOptions, Document.Sign attaches a digital signature, and Document.VerifySignatures returns the verification status of each signature field.
Document.ValidatePDFA and Document.ValidatePDFUA check conformance to PDF/A and PDF/UA standards, while Document.ConvertToPDFA and Document.ConvertToPDFUA convert a document to those formats.
Document.SaveHTML, Document.SaveSVG, Document.SaveMarkdown, and Document.RenderImage export a document or its pages to HTML, SVG, Markdown, and raster images respectively.

ai.SummaryCopilot produces document summaries with an AI model, while ai.ChatCopilot answers questions about a document, ai.NewLLMOCREngine recognizes text on scanned pages, and ai.NewImageDescriptionCopilot describes images with a vision model.
Document.Split, Document.Append, Document.Rotate, and Document.Reorder manipulate page order and content, with Document.Split returning a new document containing the selected pages.
Document.NewFlow creates a new Flow document generator, FlowOptions.Tagged enables Tagged PDF output, and Flow.Render produces the final document.

Document.AddBlankPage, Document.DeletePage, Document.InsertBlankPage, and Document.PageCount manage page count and blank pages, with AddBlankPage and InsertBlankPage appending or inserting empty pages.
Document.Flatten, Annotation.Flatten, Document.ApplyRedactions, and Form.Flatten merge interactive content into the page content, removing interactivity.
